# BackBiome Notebook (backbiome.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for BackBiome, a once-daily vegetable capsule (30 per bottle) marketed to support back comfort and flexibility in adults. Seller-described ingredients, no amounts given: probiotic complex (strains not named), turmeric root extract, boswellia serrata, ginger root extract, bromelain, magnesium glycinate and an unnamed antioxidant support blend. Directions per the seller: one capsule daily with a full meal. Bundles: 2 bottles $69 each ($138 plus $9.99 shipping), 3 bottles $59 each ($177, free shipping, 1 bonus book), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping, 2 bonus books and VIP area); 60-day money-back guarantee, bottles returned full or empty.

IMPORTANT: BackBiome is a supplement, not a treatment, cure or reversal for back pain, disc problems or sciatica; the bottle says Supports Back and Spine Pain Reduction and Clinically Studied Ingredients but no study of the capsule is shown. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Back pain with bladder or bowel changes, groin numbness, worsening leg weakness, fever or injury needs urgent care. Ingredients may affect bleeding, kidneys, antibiotic absorption and gallbladders; probiotics need care with weak immunity. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people should consult a physician.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
